verdict.rationale: Brex's developer APIs (Transactions, Accounting, Expenses, Team) allow programmatic read access to financial data in JSON, which technically enables data extraction in an open format, but there is no explicit 'export all your data' feature, bulk-export tool, or documented data-portability guarantee for account closure. Community reports of abrupt account closures (e.g. 6-week or 45-day notices) never mention any structured export process being offered to departing customers. missing for 10: explicit bulk data export/portability documentation, confirmation that API coverage is comprehensive enough to capture 100% of account data, and evidence of smooth data retrieval during account closures.
